title: A Will for the Portrait
author: Isandro Thornbury
blurb: Ivo Zhou, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
